en.title: Ollama Docker Deployment
en.summary: Reproducible container setup for local LLM serving, persistence, service integration, and hosted demonstrations.
en.challenge: Local LLM experimentation becomes difficult to reproduce when model serving, dependencies, persistence, and network settings are installed manually on each machine.
contribution: Packaged Ollama and its supporting service configuration into a repeatable Docker Compose workflow.
Documented model startup, persistence, environment settings, and deployment paths.
Published a public repository and hosted demonstration endpoint for easier evaluation.
technical: Docker Compose defines the model runtime, service networking, volumes, and application dependencies.
Python service code exposes health and model-facing integration points for local or hosted use.
Environment-based configuration keeps development and cloud deployment paths aligned.

architecture.label: Client
architecture.detail: Local applications or API users send prompts or health requests.

architecture.label: Application service
architecture.detail: Python integration layer validates and forwards model operations.

architecture.label: Model runtime
architecture.detail: Ollama serves configured models inside an isolated container with persistent storage.

architecture.label: Delivery
architecture.detail: Docker Compose runs locally; the same configuration can be adapted for hosted demonstrations.

outcomes: Makes a multi-service local LLM environment reproducible with one documented startup path.
Provides a reusable base for later RAG, chatbot, and copilot prototypes.
Demonstrates container, API, and model-runtime integration beyond notebook experimentation.

zh.title: Ollama Docker 部署
zh.summary: 可重現的本機 LLM 容器化設定，涵蓋持久化、服務整合與線上展示。
zh.role: 後端與 DevOps 工程師
zh.challenge: 若在每台電腦上手動安裝模型服務、相依套件、持久化與網路設定，本地 LLM 實驗將難以重現。
contribution: 將 Ollama 與其支援服務設定封裝為可重複使用的 Docker Compose 工作流程。
記錄模型啟動、持久化、環境設定與部署路徑。
發布公開儲存庫與線上展示端點，降低評估門檻。
technical: Docker Compose 定義模型執行環境、服務網路、Volume 與應用程式相依項目。
Python 服務程式碼提供健康檢查及面向模型的整合端點，支援本地或託管使用。
以環境變數為基礎的設定，讓開發與雲端部署路徑保持一致。

architecture.label: 用戶端
architecture.detail: 本地應用程式或 API 使用者送出提示詞或健康檢查請求。

architecture.label: 應用服務
architecture.detail: Python 整合層驗證並轉送模型操作。

architecture.label: 模型執行環境
architecture.detail: Ollama 在具持久化儲存的隔離容器內提供指定模型。

architecture.label: 交付
architecture.detail: Docker Compose 可在本地啟動，同一設定也能調整為線上展示。

outcomes: 透過一條文件化的啟動路徑，讓多服務本地 LLM 環境可重現。
為後續 RAG、聊天機器人與 Copilot 原型提供可重用基礎。
展現超越 Notebook 實驗的容器、API 與模型執行環境整合能力。
